title: Homestead Creamery
description: About Homestead Creamery Homestead Creamery specializes in premium dairy products made from milk sourced from local A2A2 cows. They offer minimally pasteurized milk, rich ice cream, and all-natural lemonade, all crafted to preserve flavor and quality. Their products are available in returnable glass bottles and can be found in various stores. The company aims to provide delicious, wholesome dairy options for consumers who appreciate quality and taste. As a result of the attack on Company Homestead Creamery, more than 70 GB of confidential data was stolen. More than 120,000 files were not secured by Company and contain data such as banking and other financial information, as well as employees' personal data.
